properties.name: bootui.activity.feed-source
properties.description: Where the activity stream comes from: {@code journal}, rendering the runtime journal's retained events with every child nested by request or execution id. {@code buffers}, 1.x's feed, was removed in 2.0.0 and fails the start; with the journal disabled, the panel buffers serve the feed on their own. A request may override it with {@code ?source=}.

properties.name: bootui.activity.max-entries
properties.description: Maximum number of normalized entries returned in a single activity-stream page after merging and sorting all sources.

properties.name: bootui.activity.max-scheduled-task-runs
properties.description: Maximum number of recent {@code @Scheduled} task executions retained for the {@code SCHEDULED} entries in the activity stream.

properties.name: bootui.activity.n-plus-one-threshold
properties.description: Number of identical normalized SELECT statements correlated to a single request above which an N+1 hint is surfaced in the per-request profile.

properties.name: bootui.activity.persistence.buffer-max-entries
properties.description: Capacity of both the in-memory hot read cache (entries visible immediately, even before their scheduled flush) and the pending-flush queue (entries awaiting their first durable write).

properties.name: bootui.activity.persistence.data-source-mode
properties.description: Where the durable store gets its JDBC connections from: {@code SHARED} reuses the host application's own {@code DataSource} bean (the same one BootUI's SQL Trace panel may already be tracing), {@code DEDICATED} opens a small, non-pooled connection of BootUI's own using the {@code dedicated-*} properties below.

properties.name: bootui.activity.persistence.dedicated-driver-class-name
properties.description: Optional explicit JDBC driver class to load for {@code data-source-mode=DEDICATED}; blank lets the driver auto-register itself from the classpath (the usual case for a modern JDBC 4+ driver).

properties.name: bootui.activity.persistence.dedicated-jdbc-url
properties.description: JDBC URL for {@code data-source-mode=DEDICATED}, otherwise ignored.

properties.name: bootui.activity.persistence.dedicated-password
properties.description: Password for {@code data-source-mode=DEDICATED}, otherwise ignored.

properties.name: bootui.activity.persistence.dedicated-username
properties.description: Username for {@code data-source-mode=DEDICATED}, otherwise ignored.

properties.name: bootui.activity.persistence.enabled
properties.description: Whether captured Live Activity entries are also durably persisted, in addition to today's in-memory-only default. Disabled by default: no background thread, connection or bean beyond what already exists is created while this is {@code false}.

properties.name: bootui.activity.persistence.flush-interval
properties.description: How often buffered entries are flushed to durable storage.

properties.name: bootui.activity.persistence.instance-id
properties.description: The multi-tenant partition key this running instance writes and reads its rows under, so several BootUI instances can safely share one database table. Defaults to the {@code HOSTNAME} environment variable (a natural, stable identity for a container/Kubernetes pod) or else a generated {@code <app-name>-<random>} id, computed once at startup.

properties.name: bootui.activity.persistence.retention
properties.description: How long persisted rows are kept before being pruned; entries older than this are eligible for deletion on this instance's own next prune pass. Only this instance's own rows are ever pruned.

properties.name: bootui.activity.persistence.table-name
properties.description: Table name every BootUI instance pointed at the same database shares. Must be a plain SQL identifier; created automatically on first use if it does not already exist.

properties.name: bootui.activity.request-slow-threshold-ms
properties.description: Duration in milliseconds at or above which a request is slow, on every stack: it sets the {@code SLOW} severity of Live Activity request and scheduled-task entries, and classifies HTTP exchanges for the reserved share of the HTTP Exchanges buffer. Set to {@code 0} to disable slow classification.

properties.name: bootui.agent.allow-in-disabled-profiles
properties.description: Whether this application claims the BootUI agent when {@code bootui.enabled=ON} forces BootUI on despite an active {@code bootui.disabled-profiles} entry, such as {@code prod}. Off by default: the agent must never be attached to a production JVM.

properties.name: bootui.agent.enabled
properties.description: Whether this application claims the BootUI agent when the JVM runs with it attached.

properties.name: bootui.agent.executors.max-handoff
properties.description: How long a task's work is attributed to the request that handed it over; work recorded later, and tasks ending later, are not.

properties.name: bootui.agent.executors.skip-tasks
properties.description: Task class-name prefixes the sensor never propagates, because they already carry their context, such as Micrometer's and Spring's context-propagating wrappers.

properties.name: bootui.agent.executors.skip-threads
properties.description: Worker thread-name prefixes the sensor never propagates to, because their executor carries the context itself. With Reactor's automatic context propagation on, Reactor's scheduler threads are added.

properties.name: bootui.agent.mode
properties.description: The claim's mode: {@code dev}, {@code test}, or {@code auto}, which is {@code test} when the application starts under JUnit, TestNG, Cucumber, or Spring Boot's test support. A development application takes the agent over from a test one.

properties.name: bootui.agent.packages
properties.description: Application package prefixes the agent may instrument, in addition to the main application class's package and the auto-configuration packages.

properties.name: bootui.agent.ring-capacity
properties.description: The records the agent's transport ring holds before it drops new ones, clamped to 1,024 to 4,194,304 and rounded up to a power of two. Each record takes 64 bytes; the first claim of the JVM sizes the ring.

properties.name: bootui.agent.security-sinks.request-values
properties.description: Whether the current request's query and path parameter values of at least 4 characters are held while the request runs, so a sink it reaches (SQL text, a command, a file path, an outbound URL) can be checked for one appearing verbatim. Opt-in. The values are compared, never stored, logged, or displayed, and are forgotten when the response completes. Needs the {@code security-sinks} sensor.

properties.name: bootui.agent.sensors
properties.description: The agent sensors this application asks for. {@code executors} propagates a request's context through the JDK's executors, so work handed to a raw thread pool or {@code CompletableFuture} is owned by its request. {@code inventory} records which application methods ran in this run and which jars loaded classes. {@code code-paths} times the application's bean methods per request, as call trees. {@code processes} records the processes the application starts, for Side Effects: the command's file name, never its arguments or environment. {@code network} records the hosts the application connects to, the datagrams it sends, and the names the JVM resolves, for Side Effects: a host and port, never a byte sent or received. {@code files} records the files the application opens, deletes, moves, and copies, as path patterns, never contents. {@code blocking} records {@code Thread.sleep}, {@code Object.wait}, {@code LockSupport.park}, and the network and files sensors' blocking operations started on an event loop, for Side Effects. {@code resources} reports the sockets, file streams, and channels a request or a job left open past the request or never closed before the collector reclaimed them, never contents. An unknown sensor id fails the application's start. {@code threads}, opt-in, also propagates a request's context into threads started from application code and into virtual threads. {@code environment}, opt-in, records the names of the environment variables and system properties the application reads, never their values. {@code caught-exceptions}, opt-in, reports the exceptions application code catches and which of them are thrown again, never their message, to the runtime journal.

properties.name: bootui.ai.max-recent-chats
properties.description: Maximum number of recent chat completions surfaced by the AI panel.

properties.name: bootui.ai.show-content-capture-banner
properties.description: When true, BootUI surfaces a banner explaining that prompt/completion content is not captured by default.

properties.name: bootui.ai.token-series-minutes
properties.description: Number of minutes retained in the per-minute token-usage series.

properties.name: bootui.allow-non-localhost
properties.description: Allow non-loopback requests (explicit opt-out of safety).

properties.name: bootui.allowed-hosts
properties.description: Additional Host header values accepted by the loopback safety filter, beyond the built-in loopback names (localhost, 127.0.0.1, ::1). Used to defend against DNS-rebinding attacks while still allowing custom local hostnames.

properties.name: bootui.api-path
properties.description: Internal API base path. Defaults to {@code bootui.path + "/api"}. Override only when the API must be served at a different sub-path from the UI (rare).

properties.name: bootui.authentication.token
properties.description: Optional bearer token for non-loopback API access. When blank, BootUI generates one at startup.

properties.name: bootui.cache.activity-capture-enabled
properties.description: Whether BootUI wraps {@code CacheManager} beans to capture hit/miss/put/evict/clear accesses into the Live Activity panel's {@code CACHE} event type. Cache keys are always hashed, never recorded raw, regardless of value exposure. When {@code false}, no {@code CacheManager} is wrapped and cache accesses never appear in Live Activity.

properties.name: bootui.cache.activity-max-events
properties.description: Maximum number of recent cache accesses retained in the in-memory ring buffer feeding Live Activity.

properties.name: bootui.cache.clear-enabled
properties.description: Allow BootUI to clear application caches from the Cache panel.

properties.name: bootui.claude-code.allow-raw-reveal
properties.description: Allow the opt-in raw-event reveal endpoint. When {@code false}, the endpoint returns HTTP 404 even on the loopback interface.

properties.name: bootui.claude-code.enabled
properties.description: Enable the Copilot panel. AUTO activates only when the session-state directory exists.

properties.name: bootui.claude-code.max-events-per-session
properties.description: Maximum number of activity events retained per session in memory.

properties.name: bootui.claude-code.max-parsed-sessions
properties.description: Maximum number of recent session files parsed and retained in memory.

properties.name: bootui.claude-code.max-sessions
properties.description: Maximum number of recent sessions returned to the session explorer.

properties.name: bootui.claude-code.session-state-dir
properties.description: Override the directory scanned for Copilot CLI session-state directories. When {@code null}, defaults to {@code ${user.home}/.copilot/session-state}.

properties.name: bootui.claude-code.stream-debounce
properties.description: Debounce window applied to file-system events before refreshing parsed sessions and notifying SSE subscribers.

properties.name: bootui.cli.enabled
properties.description: Whether {@code /bootui/api/cli} answers. {@code true} by default; {@code false} returns 503.

properties.name: bootui.cli.execution-timeout
properties.description: Maximum wall-clock duration of one command-line tool invocation; default 30 seconds (504 on expiry).

properties.name: bootui.cli.max-concurrent-calls
properties.description: Maximum number of concurrent command-line tool invocations; default 20. Excess calls get a 429.

properties.name: bootui.cli.max-results
properties.description: Maximum number of items returned by paginated read tools in a single call. Mirrors {@code bootui.mcp.max-results} but is tracked separately so command-line traffic can be tuned without changing what agents see.

properties.name: bootui.code-inventory.max-classes
properties.description: Most application classes the scan of the application's class files hashes; past it the scan is partial.

properties.name: bootui.code-inventory.scan-timeout
properties.description: Deadline of that scan, which runs off the request path once per run; past it the scan is partial.

properties.name: bootui.copilot.allow-raw-reveal
properties.description: Allow the opt-in raw-event reveal endpoint. When {@code false}, the endpoint returns HTTP 404 even on the loopback interface.

properties.name: bootui.copilot.enabled
properties.description: Enable the Copilot panel. AUTO activates only when the session-state directory exists.

properties.name: bootui.copilot.max-events-per-session
properties.description: Maximum number of activity events retained per session in memory.

properties.name: bootui.copilot.max-parsed-sessions
properties.description: Maximum number of recent session files parsed and retained in memory.

properties.name: bootui.copilot.max-sessions
properties.description: Maximum number of recent sessions returned to the session explorer.

properties.name: bootui.copilot.session-state-dir
properties.description: Override the directory scanned for Copilot CLI session-state directories. When {@code null}, defaults to {@code ${user.home}/.copilot/session-state}.

properties.name: bootui.copilot.stream-debounce
properties.description: Debounce window applied to file-system events before refreshing parsed sessions and notifying SSE subscribers.

properties.name: bootui.dev-services.log-tail-bytes
properties.description: Maximum bytes returned by a single Dev Services log request.

properties.name: bootui.dev-services.restart-enabled
properties.description: Allow BootUI to restart Testcontainers-backed services.

properties.name: bootui.disabled-profiles
properties.description: Profiles that force BootUI off, even when enabled by other rules.

properties.name: bootui.email.dev-trap
properties.description: When {@code true}, captured messages are recorded but never actually handed to the real mail transport (like MailDev/GreenMail's dev-trap behavior). Off by default, so BootUI never silently swallows application mail.

properties.name: bootui.email.mask-content
properties.description: When {@code true}, captured recipients/subject/body are masked unless {@code bootui.expose- values=FULL}, matching BootUI's config/secret masking. Off by default: email content is ordinary application data (not credentials), so it is revealed by default — like Laravel Telescope's Mail watcher and like BootUI's own HTTP Exchanges/SQL Trace panels — decoupled from the global secret-exposure flag so reading a test email never requires exposing unrelated production secrets (or vice versa).

properties.name: bootui.email.max-body-length
properties.description: Maximum number of characters retained per captured text/HTML body; a longer body is truncated at capture time. Bounds memory for a single oversized message the same way {@link #maxEntries} bounds the number of retained messages (attachment content is never captured in the first place, so only bodies need this cap).

properties.name: bootui.email.max-entries
properties.description: Maximum number of captured messages retained; the oldest is evicted once full.

properties.name: bootui.enabled
properties.description: Enable BootUI. AUTO activates only in dev/local contexts.

properties.name: bootui.enabled-profiles
properties.description: Profiles that trigger auto-activation.

properties.name: bootui.exceptions.max-groups
properties.description: Maximum number of distinct exception groups retained by the Exceptions panel. When the limit is reached the group with the oldest most-recent occurrence is evicted.

properties.name: bootui.exceptions.max-occurrences-per-group
properties.description: Maximum number of recent occurrences retained per exception group.

properties.name: bootui.exceptions.max-stack-frames
properties.description: Maximum number of stack-trace frames retained per exception (and per cause).

properties.name: bootui.expose-values
properties.description: How configuration values are exposed in the Config panel.

properties.name: bootui.fault-tolerance.enabled
properties.description: Whether BootUI subscribes to the fault tolerance libraries' own event publishers and listeners. When {@code false}, declared policies are still listed but no outcome is captured and no {@code FAULT_TOLERANCE} entry reaches Live Activity.

properties.name: bootui.fault-tolerance.max-events
properties.description: Maximum number of captured fault tolerance outcomes retained in the in-memory ring buffer.

properties.name: bootui.force-web
properties.description: While BootUI is active, force a non-web (command-line) application into a servlet web application so the BootUI console can be served. Has no effect on applications that are already servlet web applications or that are explicitly configured as reactive. Set to false to leave the host application's web-application type untouched.

properties.name: bootui.free-on-idle.enabled
properties.description: Whether BootUI releases its live in-memory diagnostic buffers (captured SQL, ingested traces, and the request/security correlation windows) after the console has been idle for {@code timeout}, and stops recording into them until the console is used again. The Exceptions and Log Tail buffers are kept so a recent error is still visible when you open the console. Has no effect in production, where BootUI is inactive.

properties.name: bootui.free-on-idle.timeout
properties.description: How long the console may go without any request before its live buffers are released. The timer resets on every BootUI request (loading the UI, API polling, or opening a stream), so an open console never reclaims; only a genuinely unused one does. Clamped to a minimum of one second.

properties.name: bootui.github.allowed-api-hosts
properties.description: Additional allowed GitHub API hosts. GitHub.com is allowed by default.

properties.name: bootui.github.api-enabled
properties.description: Allow the GitHub panel refresh action to call GitHub APIs.

properties.name: bootui.github.max-api-calls
properties.description: Maximum number of GitHub API calls issued by one refresh.

properties.name: bootui.github.max-issues
properties.description: Maximum issues returned in one dashboard refresh.

properties.name: bootui.github.max-pull-requests
properties.description: Maximum pull requests returned in one dashboard refresh.

properties.name: bootui.github.max-security-alerts
properties.description: Maximum Dependabot alert details listed in one dashboard refresh. The alert count is still exact; only the inlined detail list is capped. Code scanning and secret scanning remain count-only and never inline alert details.

properties.name: bootui.github.max-workflow-runs
properties.description: Maximum workflow runs returned in one dashboard refresh.

properties.name: bootui.github.quota-safety-threshold
properties.description: Safety threshold below which optional GitHub calls are skipped.

properties.name: bootui.github.request-timeout
properties.description: Timeout applied to each GitHub API request and local credential lookup.

properties.name: bootui.graalvm.max-repository-lookups
properties.description: Maximum number of distinct dependency coordinates looked up against the reachability metadata repository in a single scan.

properties.name: bootui.graalvm.repository-lookup-enabled
properties.description: Allow the GraalVM dependency survey to look up Oracle's GraalVM reachability metadata repository for per-version coverage of classpath dependencies. The lookup is the panel's only outbound network call and is performed only during a user-initiated dependency scan.

properties.name: bootui.graalvm.repository-lookup-timeout
properties.description: Timeout applied to each reachability metadata repository request.

properties.name: bootui.heap-dump.allow-raw-download
properties.description: Allow downloading the raw {@code .hprof} file over HTTP. Disabled by default because the raw dump contains unmasked secrets.

properties.name: bootui.heap-dump.capture-enabled
properties.description: Allow on-demand heap dump capture. When {@code false}, the panel still exposes the live class histogram analysis but the capture endpoint is rejected.

properties.name: bootui.heap-dump.max-classes
properties.description: Maximum number of classes retained in memory after a histogram analysis, ordered by retained bytes. Capping this value prevents very large heaps from exhausting memory. Must be ≥ {@code top-classes}.

properties.name: bootui.heap-dump.max-dumps
properties.description: Maximum number of heap dump files retained on disk. Oldest dumps are deleted first.

properties.name: bootui.heap-dump.output-dir
properties.description: Directory where captured heap dumps are written.

properties.name: bootui.heap-dump.top-classes
properties.description: Maximum number of classes returned in the class histogram, ordered by retained bytes.

properties.name: bootui.http-exchanges.max-exchanges
properties.description: Maximum number of HTTP exchanges retained in the in-memory repository.

properties.name: bootui.http-exchanges.reserved-share-percent
properties.description: Percentage of the retained exchanges reserved for the most recent 5xx and slow exchanges (at or above {@code bootui.activity.request-slow-threshold-ms}), so routine traffic is evicted first. Taken out of {@code max-exchanges}, never added to it. Set to {@code 0} to evict strictly oldest first. Applies only when BootUI owns the repository.

properties.name: bootui.http-sessions.max-sessions
properties.description: Maximum number of active HTTP sessions returned by the HTTP Sessions panel.

properties.name: bootui.jms.capture-message-id
properties.description: Whether a provider-assigned JMS message ID is retained as a truncated SHA-256 hash. The raw message ID is never stored.

properties.name: bootui.jms.enabled
properties.description: Whether BootUI captures {@link org.springframework.jms.core.JmsTemplate} sends and {@code @JmsListener} deliveries into the Live Activity stream as {@code MESSAGING} entries. When {@code false}, no JMS bean is post-processed. Only takes effect when {@code spring-jms} is on the classpath.

properties.name: bootui.jms.max-entries
properties.description: Maximum number of JMS messages retained in the in-memory ring buffer.

properties.name: bootui.jms.max-message-id-length
properties.description: Maximum retained length of the JMS message ID's hex-encoded SHA-256 hash.

properties.name: bootui.kafka.capture-key
properties.description: Whether a SHA-256 hash of the message key is retained alongside each captured entry (truncated to {@link #maxKeyLength}). The raw key is never retained. On by default since a Kafka key is typically a correlation/partitioning id rather than a secret, but this lets an application disable even the hash when its keys carry sensitive data. The message value/payload is never captured at all.

properties.name: bootui.kafka.enabled
properties.description: Whether BootUI captures {@code KafkaTemplate} sends and {@code @KafkaListener} deliveries into the Live Activity stream as {@code MESSAGING} entries. When {@code false}, no {@code KafkaTemplate}/listener container factory bean is post-processed. Only takes effect when {@code spring-kafka} is on the classpath.

properties.name: bootui.kafka.max-entries
properties.description: Maximum number of captured messages retained in the in-memory ring buffer.

properties.name: bootui.kafka.max-key-length
properties.description: Maximum retained length of the message key's hex-encoded SHA-256 hash.

properties.name: bootui.log-tail.max-bytes
properties.description: Approximate retained-byte budget for the in-memory Log Tail ring buffer, bounding it alongside its fixed line cap (oldest evicted first when either bound trips). {@code 0} (the default) means unbounded — preserving the Spring adapter's historical behaviour — and matches the Quarkus adapter's {@code bootui.log-tail.max-bytes} default, so the same key sizes the buffer identically on both frameworks.

properties.name: bootui.mask-secrets
properties.description: Mask secret-like configuration values.

properties.name: bootui.mcp.enabled
properties.description: Initial state of the local MCP server. {@link Mode#OFF} by default (fail closed); {@link Mode#ON} starts the server enabled. {@link Mode#AUTO} is treated the same as {@link Mode#OFF} so the server is never silently exposed. The MCP Server panel can override this at runtime.

properties.name: bootui.mcp.execution-timeout
properties.description: Maximum wall-clock duration of one MCP tool invocation; default 30 seconds.

properties.name: bootui.mcp.max-concurrent-calls
properties.description: Maximum number of concurrent MCP tool invocations; default 20. Excess requests get a JSON-RPC error immediately.

properties.name: bootui.mcp.max-payload-bytes
properties.description: Maximum request payload bytes; default 1MB. Requests exceeding this are rejected before parsing.

properties.name: bootui.mcp.max-response-bytes
properties.description: Maximum rendered JSON-RPC response size; default 4MB.

properties.name: bootui.mcp.max-results
properties.description: Maximum number of items returned by paginated read tools (config, beans, mappings, security logs, traces, HTTP exchanges) in a single call.

properties.name: bootui.monitoring.exclude-self
properties.description: Hide BootUI's own runtime data from monitoring panels.

properties.name: bootui.mysql.max-indexes
properties.description: Maximum index activity rows per datasource. Requires restart.

properties.name: bootui.mysql.max-lock-waits
properties.description: Maximum lock-wait observations per datasource. Requires restart.

properties.name: bootui.mysql.max-replication-channels
properties.description: Maximum local replication channels per datasource. Requires restart.

properties.name: bootui.mysql.max-sessions
properties.description: Maximum session rows per datasource; positive and below 2147483647. Requires restart.

properties.name: bootui.mysql.max-settings
properties.description: Maximum displayed settings from the fixed allow-list. Requires restart.

properties.name: bootui.mysql.max-statements
properties.description: Maximum normalized statements ranked by total execution time. Requires restart.

properties.name: bootui.mysql.max-tables
properties.description: Maximum table rows per datasource. Requires restart.

properties.name: bootui.overrides-file
properties.description: Where local runtime overrides are persisted.

properties.name: bootui.panels
properties.description: Per-panel visibility and action settings keyed by panel id.

properties.name: bootui.path
properties.description: UI base path. Must be an absolute path (starting with {@code /}), not {@code /}, and must not contain path-traversal, query, or fragment components. Trailing slashes are stripped. The API path is automatically derived as {@code path + "/api"} unless {@code bootui.api-path} is also set.

properties.name: bootui.postgresql.max-indexes
properties.description: Maximum index rows per datasource. Must be between 1 and 2147483646; requires restart.

properties.name: bootui.postgresql.max-replicas
properties.description: Maximum replica rows per datasource. Must be between 1 and 2147483646; requires restart.

properties.name: bootui.postgresql.max-sessions
properties.description: Maximum session rows per datasource. Must be between 1 and 2147483646; requires restart.

properties.name: bootui.postgresql.max-settings
properties.description: Maximum curated setting rows per datasource. Must be between 1 and 2147483646; requires restart.

properties.name: bootui.postgresql.max-statements
properties.description: Maximum statements ranked by total execution time. Must be between 1 and 2147483646; requires restart.

properties.name: bootui.postgresql.max-tables
properties.description: Maximum table rows per datasource. Must be between 1 and 2147483646; requires restart.

properties.name: bootui.postgresql.max-vacuum-tables
properties.description: Maximum autovacuum table rows per datasource. Must be between 1 and 2147483646; requires restart.

properties.name: bootui.rabbitmq.capture-correlation-id
properties.description: Whether the AMQP correlation ID is retained (as a short SHA-256 hash, truncated to {@link #maxCorrelationIdLength}) alongside each captured entry. Off by default since correlation IDs in AMQP messages can carry business-sensitive identifiers (order IDs, user IDs, etc.). When enabled, only the hash is stored — never the raw value.

properties.name: bootui.rabbitmq.enabled
properties.description: Whether BootUI captures {@code RabbitTemplate} publishes and {@code @RabbitListener} deliveries into the Live Activity stream as {@code MESSAGING} entries. When {@code false}, no {@code RabbitTemplate}/listener container factory bean is post-processed. Only takes effect when {@code spring-boot-starter-amqp} (and thus {@code spring-rabbit}) is on the classpath.

properties.name: bootui.rabbitmq.max-correlation-id-length
properties.description: Maximum retained length of a captured correlation ID hash; longer hashes are truncated.

properties.name: bootui.rabbitmq.max-entries
properties.description: Maximum number of captured messages retained in the in-memory ring buffer.

properties.name: bootui.read-only
properties.description: Disable every browser-triggered action while keeping read-only panel data visible.

properties.name: bootui.resources.jfr.max-duration
properties.description: How long a session records once the developer starts it. Between 1 s and 10 min.

properties.name: bootui.resources.max-threads
properties.description: The most platform threads one sweep reads; the CPU time of the others counts as the JVM's own work.

properties.name: bootui.resources.sample-interval
properties.description: How often the sampler sweeps the JVM's threads, CPU time, and heap. At least 100 ms.

properties.name: bootui.rest-client-trace.capture-call-site
properties.description: Whether each captured call records the first application stack frame that triggered it (e.g. {@code OrderClient.findAll(OrderClient.java:42)}), shown per call and aggregated per group so a flagged chatty group shows exactly where in the code to go fix it. On by default: unlike headers, a call site names only the application's own code (class/method/line), never a value, so it carries no sensitive-data risk — this toggle is purely about the small per-call stack-walk cost, not privacy.

properties.name: bootui.rest-client-trace.capture-headers
properties.description: Whether request headers are captured alongside each call. Off by default because header values may contain sensitive data; when enabled, values are captured as-is (subject to truncation) and then masked by header name (e.g. {@code Authorization}) at read/report time according to the live exposure policy.

properties.name: bootui.rest-client-trace.chatty-call-threshold
properties.description: Number of calls to the same method/host/path (with numeric and UUID path segments normalized) within the buffer before the group is flagged as a likely chatty (repeated-call) access pattern. Minimum {@code 2}.

properties.name: bootui.rest-client-trace.enabled
properties.description: Whether BootUI instruments Spring's {@code RestClient}, {@code RestTemplate}, and {@code WebClient} beans to capture outbound HTTP calls. When {@code false}, no customizer is registered.

properties.name: bootui.rest-client-trace.max-entries
properties.description: Maximum number of outbound calls retained in the in-memory ring buffer.

properties.name: bootui.rest-client-trace.max-header-value-length
properties.description: Maximum retained length of a single captured header value.

properties.name: bootui.rest-client-trace.max-uri-length
properties.description: Maximum retained length of the request URI and path; longer values are truncated.

properties.name: bootui.rest-client-trace.recording
properties.description: Whether new calls are recorded into the in-memory buffer. Recording can be paused and resumed at runtime from the panel without removing the client instrumentation; this sets the initial state.

properties.name: bootui.rest-client-trace.reserved-share-percent
properties.description: Percentage of the retained calls reserved for the most recent failed, error-response ({@code 4xx}/{@code 5xx}), and slow calls, so routine calls are evicted first. Taken out of {@code max-entries}, never added to it. Set to {@code 0} to evict strictly oldest first.

properties.name: bootui.rest-client-trace.slow-call-threshold-millis
properties.description: Calls taking at least this many milliseconds are flagged as slow. Set to {@code 0} to disable slow-call flagging. Defaults higher than SQL Trace's threshold since outbound HTTP calls are typically slower than a single SQL execution.

properties.name: bootui.runtime-insights.ai-token-threshold
properties.description: Tokens of one model call above which AI usage by route reports the route from that call alone, rather than from three operations.

properties.name: bootui.runtime-journal.agent-evidence-max-bytes
properties.description: Maximum memory the BootUI agent's evidence kept outside the journal may use, estimated: Code Paths' request and route trees, Code Inventory's first calls, and Side Effects' rows. Unset means about 68 MB, the sum of their fixed caps; a smaller value shrinks Code Paths' trees and Side Effects' rows in proportion, and Code Inventory's first calls, bounded by the agent's method limit, are only counted.

properties.name: bootui.runtime-journal.baseline-file
properties.description: File that keeps the summary of the last run across a full JVM restart, such as {@code target/bootui-baseline.bin}: written when a run ends and read at the next start when this JVM keeps no previous run. It holds route templates, statement fingerprints, edges, counts, and histograms only. Relative to the working directory; its directory must exist. Unset writes and reads nothing.

properties.name: bootui.runtime-journal.enabled
properties.description: Whether the journal records runtime events.

properties.name: bootui.runtime-journal.max-bytes
properties.description: Maximum memory the retained events may use, estimated per event. Unset means the smaller of 32 MB and 5 % of the maximum heap.

properties.name: bootui.runtime-journal.max-events
properties.description: Maximum number of events retained as evidence. Aggregates count every event, retained or not.

properties.name: bootui.runtime-journal.queue-capacity
properties.description: Maximum number of events waiting to be recorded. The last 10 % admits only failed or slow events; beyond it, events are dropped and counted, and the application thread never waits.

properties.name: bootui.runtime-journal.sources
properties.description: Sources to record: {@code http}, {@code sql}, {@code transaction}, {@code connection}, {@code exception}, {@code security}, {@code authorization}, {@code rest-client}, {@code cache}, {@code messaging}, {@code scheduled}, {@code log}, {@code mail}, {@code fault-tolerance}, {@code ai}, {@code lifecycle}, {@code gc}, and {@code resources}. Unset means every source; an unknown name fails startup.

properties.name: bootui.security-logs.max-logs
properties.description: Maximum number of recent audit events retained in a single Security Logs response.

properties.name: bootui.show-banner
properties.description: Print the BootUI URL on application startup.

properties.name: bootui.sql-trace.capture-call-site
properties.description: Whether each captured statement records the first application stack frame that triggered it (e.g. {@code OrderRepository.findByCustomer(OrderRepository.java:42)}), shown per execution and aggregated per group so a flagged N+1 group shows exactly where in the code to go fix it. On by default: unlike bound parameters, a call site names only the application's own code (class/method/line), never a value, so it carries no sensitive-data risk — this toggle is purely about the small per-statement stack-walk cost, not privacy.

properties.name: bootui.sql-trace.capture-parameters
properties.description: Whether bound statement parameters are captured alongside the SQL text. Off by default because parameter values may contain sensitive data; metadata-only value exposure additionally suppresses parameters even when this is enabled.

properties.name: bootui.sql-trace.enabled
properties.description: Whether BootUI wraps {@code DataSource} beans with its hand-written JDBC tracing proxy to capture executed SQL. When {@code false}, no data source is wrapped.

properties.name: bootui.sql-trace.max-entries
properties.description: Maximum number of executed statements retained in the in-memory ring buffer.

properties.name: bootui.sql-trace.max-parameter-length
properties.description: Maximum retained length of a single captured parameter value.

properties.name: bootui.sql-trace.max-sql-length
properties.description: Maximum retained SQL text length; longer statements are truncated.

properties.name: bootui.sql-trace.n-plus-one-threshold
properties.description: Number of times an identical {@code SELECT} must repeat within the buffer before it is flagged as a likely N+1 access pattern. Minimum {@code 2}.

properties.name: bootui.sql-trace.recording
properties.description: Whether new executions are recorded into the in-memory buffer. Recording can be paused and resumed at runtime from the panel without unwrapping {@code DataSource} beans; this sets the initial state.

properties.name: bootui.sql-trace.reserved-share-percent
properties.description: Percentage of the retained executions reserved for the most recent failed and slow executions, so routine executions are evicted first. Taken out of {@code max-entries}, never added to it. Set to {@code 0} to evict strictly oldest first.

properties.name: bootui.sql-trace.slow-query-threshold-millis
properties.description: Executions taking at least this many milliseconds are flagged as slow. Set to {@code 0} to disable slow-query flagging.

properties.name: bootui.startup.capacity
properties.description: Maximum startup steps retained by BootUI's auto-installed startup buffer. Values less than or equal to zero disable the buffer.

properties.name: bootui.startup.enabled
properties.description: Install a BufferingApplicationStartup automatically while BootUI is active so the Startup Timeline panel has data.

properties.name: bootui.telemetry.enabled
properties.description: Capture local trace spans and accept OTLP/HTTP trace payloads at the BootUI OTLP endpoint.

properties.name: bootui.telemetry.enrich
properties.description: Stamp BootUI {@code bootui.*} enrichment attributes on request spans (service identity, SQL volume / N+1 suspicion, exception presence) so a cross-service trace waterfall carries BootUI depth. On by default when telemetry is enabled; set to {@code false} to leave capture on but suppress enrichment.

properties.name: bootui.telemetry.exclude-self-spans
properties.description: Drop spans whose route/path attribute starts with the BootUI API path.

properties.name: bootui.telemetry.max-attribute-value-bytes
properties.description: Maximum length of a single attribute string value before truncation.

properties.name: bootui.telemetry.max-request-bytes
properties.description: Maximum payload size (bytes) accepted by the OTLP receiver.

properties.name: bootui.telemetry.max-spans-per-trace
properties.description: Maximum number of spans retained per trace.

properties.name: bootui.telemetry.max-traces
properties.description: Maximum number of distinct traces retained in memory. Oldest are evicted.

properties.name: bootui.transactions.connection-hold-threshold-millis
properties.description: Transactions taking at least this many milliseconds are flagged as holding a pooled connection too long. Set to {@code 0} to disable connection-hold flagging.

properties.name: bootui.transactions.enabled
properties.description: Whether BootUI registers its transaction-execution listener against {@code PlatformTransactionManager} beans to capture transaction boundaries. When {@code false}, no listener is registered.

properties.name: bootui.transactions.max-entries
properties.description: Maximum number of completed transactions retained in the in-memory ring buffer.

properties.name: bootui.transactions.recording
properties.description: Whether new transactions are recorded into the in-memory buffer. Recording can be paused and resumed at runtime from the panel without unregistering the listener; this sets the initial state.

properties.name: bootui.transactions.slow-transaction-threshold-millis
properties.description: Transactions taking at least this many milliseconds are flagged as slow. Set to {@code 0} to disable slow-transaction flagging.

properties.name: bootui.trust-container-gateway
properties.description: Trust the auto-detected container default gateway as a single /32 so BootUI can be reached inside a container with a published port (host->container traffic is SNAT'd to the gateway) without a broad bootui.trusted-proxies CIDR. Defaults to OFF (fail closed); AUTO and ON are explicit opt-ins. OFF never trusts it; AUTO trusts it only when running inside a container; ON trusts a detected gateway even if container heuristics are inconclusive. Relaxes only the source-address check; the Host allow-list and cross-site write protections stay in force.

properties.name: bootui.trusted-proxies
properties.description: Source IP ranges (CIDR notation, e.g. {@code 172.16.0.0/12}) that are trusted in addition to loopback by the safety filter. Lets local Docker-bridge callers reach BootUI without disabling the Host allow-list (DNS-rebinding defense) or the cross-site write protection (CSRF defense), unlike the all-or-nothing {@code bootui.allow-non-localhost}. Empty by default.

properties.name: bootui.vulnerabilities.epss-base-uri
properties.description: Base URI of the FIRST.org EPSS API queried during a scan. Configurable mainly so tests can point at a local stub; defaults to the public EPSS endpoint, and matches the Quarkus adapter's {@code bootui.vulnerabilities.epss-base-uri} key.

properties.name: bootui.vulnerabilities.epss-enabled
properties.description: Allow enriching CVE-aliased advisories with FIRST.org EPSS (exploit-probability) scores during a scan. Same on-demand-only network behaviour as {@code osvEnabled}: only called from the user-initiated scan action, never on page render.

properties.name: bootui.vulnerabilities.max-advisories
properties.description: Maximum number of advisory details fetched after the package query.

properties.name: bootui.vulnerabilities.max-packages
properties.description: Maximum number of dependency packages included in one OSV batch query. Packages beyond this bound are reported as {@code scan.packagesSkipped} rather than silently dropped. The default is sized to cover a typical Spring Boot application's full JAR set, which commonly exceeds 300 dependencies.

properties.name: bootui.vulnerabilities.osv-base-uri
properties.description: Base URI of the OSV.dev API queried during a scan. Configurable mainly so tests can point at a local stub; defaults to the public OSV endpoint, preserving the panel's existing network behaviour, and matches the Quarkus adapter's {@code bootui.vulnerabilities.osv-base-uri} key.

properties.name: bootui.vulnerabilities.osv-enabled
properties.description: Allow on-demand vulnerability scans against OSV.dev.

properties.name: bootui.vulnerabilities.request-timeout
properties.description: Timeout applied to each OSV request.

properties.name: bootui.websockets.capturing
properties.description: Whether activity capture starts in the recording state. Toggleable at runtime from the panel.

properties.name: bootui.websockets.enabled
properties.description: Whether the WebSockets panel installs its capture bindings at all. When {@code false} no decorator or channel interceptor is contributed, and the panel reports endpoints only.

properties.name: bootui.websockets.max-activity-entries
properties.description: Maximum number of activity entries retained in the bounded in-memory buffer.

properties.name: bootui.websockets.max-endpoints
properties.description: Maximum number of endpoints serialized into one report.

properties.name: bootui.websockets.max-sessions
properties.description: Maximum number of sessions serialized into one report.

properties.name: bootui.websockets.max-subscriptions
properties.description: Maximum number of STOMP subscriptions serialized into one report.

properties.name: bootui.websockets.max-tracked-sessions
properties.description: Maximum number of sessions for which per-session counters are retained.
